Pankaj Tripathi Interview with Neelesh Misra: Indian actor Pankaj Tripathi is popularly known for his movies Gangs of Wasseypur (2012), Stree (2018) and Newton (2017). His other popular movies are Fukrey, Masaan, Dilwale, Nil Battey Sannata, Munna Michael, Bareilly Ki Barfi, Fukrey Returns, Luka Chuppi.
In Bollywood, it was his role in Gangs of Wasseypur that he finally made his breakthrough. Pankaj Tripathi won a Special Mention at the 65th National Film Awards for his performance in Newton.
